systems.owner: State deconcentrated tax and treasury services
systems.tiers: all eight UEMOA states, Benin included; Benin's communes set the rate of the Taxe Foncière Unique within a national range

note: A regional workshop report (held 11-14 October 2021, Cotonou): local taxes are assessed, billed and collected by the State in the UEMOA states; it names no commune-run revenue system or count for Benin. Benin's digitalisation is mentioned as 'starting' (national, 2021).
